home.title: Find the right <highlight>master's in Europe</highlight> for you.
home.intro: EdFind matches Turkish students to vetted European master's programs using a short quiz, your priorities, and an AI that explains why each program fits — not just which ones rank highest.
home.signInNote: Sign in with Google · Takes about 2 minutes · We never silently boost partner universities
home.step1: Tell us about yourself — {count} quick questions, or just describe what you're looking for in your own words.
home.step2: We compare your profile against every program in our catalog — {countries} countries, real tuition, deadlines, and rankings — and pick your top 3, each with a personal explanation of why it fits (and where the trade-offs are).
home.step3: Go deeper: compare options, check housing costs and verified student insights, then track your applications in one place.
